claim_being_audited: That the current release should be certified because it meets aggregate readiness and rehearsal indicators, with certification supportable if the current model-card documentation is updated to disclose the small-business onboarding weakness.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if admissible evidence shows current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses are disclosed in current documentation or covered by approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may inform context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
When the packet plausibly supports launch readiness overall but leaves a required policy predicate unresolved, the verdict is suspicious rather than compliant.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or certification package showing the small-business onboarding weakness is disclosed in current documentation.
Provide approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance covering the identified segment weakness if disclosure is not the path relied upon.
Provide the current evaluation artifact tying the 1.3 percentage point subgroup regression to materiality or non-materiality for the named launch use case.
Provide the final certification approval record showing reviewers evaluated the current release documents rather than relying on prior family approval.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation.
The actor summary itself identifies a current subgroup regression in a named launch use case and says no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language is attached.
Aggregate readiness clearance and clean rehearsal results do not by themselves satisfy the disclosure-or-approved-mitigation predicate.
Prior approval of the model family and informal monitoring commentary are expressly contextual only under the policy and cannot close the current-documentation gap.
The recommendation overreaches the available admissible support because it depends on a documentation update that is not itself evidenced in the record provided to this role.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the current record.
That the current model-card package already reflects the current evaluation results and discloses the small-business onboarding limitation.
That any approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance exists for the identified subgroup weakness.
